title: Example Challenge Capsule
summary: A small reference capsule that demonstrates environment preparation, session tickets, claims, evidence, and restoration without launching a game.

brief.objective: Complete any test run and write an optional result file under saves/challenge-result.json.
rules: Do not change the managed ModeDOCK package environment after arming the session.
Start the game or test application through your normal launcher.
notes: The example has no package requirements, so it can be tested with an empty game directory.
The evidence file is optional; the score and completed claims are required.

handoff.label: Start with Steam, a shortcut, or your own launcher
instructions: Keep the generated ticket until the run is complete.
ModeDOCK does not launch or monitor the game process.
Finish the session with score and completed claims.
